resources.string: Snapchat for your friends — without Spotlight or Discover.
Blocks Spotlight and hides Discover in Snapchat

Moss watches the Snapchat app only. When you open Spotlight (or another tab you chose to block) it sends you back, and it covers the Discover section of the Stories tab. Moss has no internet access, never changes Snapchat itself, and ignores every other app.
○ Off — turn on “Moss – calm Snapchat” in Accessibility settings.

Is the switch greyed out (“Restricted setting”)? Android blocks this for apps installed from outside the Play Store. Tap below, then use the ⋮ menu in the top corner → “Allow restricted settings”, and try again.
Close Discover stories that open anyway
Closes stories from accounts you don’t follow, e.g. opened from search or a shared link. Friends’ stories aren’t affected. Turn off if it closes something you wanted to watch.

Nothing yet — open Snapchat once Moss is on.

Snapchat changes its layout often. If Spotlight or Discover slips through, tap Record, visit each Snapchat tab for 20 seconds, come back and tap Share. The report lists Snapchat\'s screen structure (it can include names shown on screen) so the rules can be updated. It stays on your phone unless you share it.
